prompt: I got 3 flag-as-wrong reports this week, all about receipt scanning giving wrong amounts. What should I do?

assertions.text: Identifies 3+ flags as a pattern requiring escalation to ai-engineer
Walks through the flag review workflow (context, root cause, fix, regression test)
Classifies possible root causes (prompt vs data vs model vs user misunderstanding)
Provides a time estimate for the review work
Mentions closing the loop with affected users (Taglish notification)
